name: Architecture change

title: "architecture: "

---

## Context

Describe the architectural limitation or conflict.

## Current architecture

Show the relevant current dependency flow and responsibilities.

## Proposed architecture

Show the proposed dependency flow and responsibility changes.

## Alternatives considered

List viable alternatives and why they are not preferred.

## Consequences

Describe benefits, tradeoffs, migration impact, compatibility, and operational
risks.

## Domain integrity

Explain how the proposal preserves transaction-first truth, deterministic
engines, Decimal financial values, and presentation-free business logic.

## Decision record

- [ ] Product scope is defined
- [ ] Domain design is defined
- [ ] ADR is drafted or updated
- [ ] Product Vision impact is documented
- [ ] Architecture and Roadmap updates are identified
- [ ] Migration and rollback strategy is defined

Implementation should not begin until this proposal is approved.
